title: Dragon's Den
summary: “If you wish to slay a dragon...”

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Dragon moves and fire moves are 1.5× stronger.
Ice moves and water moves are halved (0.5×).
Rock Climb, Smack Down, Strength, and Thousand Arrows also count as Fire for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Dragon Ascent, Luster Purge, Mist Ball, Smack Down, and Thousand Arrows: 2× stronger.
Diamond Storm, Earth Power, Lava Plume, Magma Storm, Make It Rain, Mega Kick, Pay Day, Power Gem, Rock Climb, Shell Trap, Stomping Tantrum, Strength, and Tera Starstorm: 1.5× stronger.
Hail and Snowscape: no effect here.
Dragon Rush: 100% accuracy.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Dragon-type.
Nature Power becomes Dragon Pulse.
Secret Power can cause burn.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Glaciate, Hydro Vortex, Oceanic Operetta, and Subzero Slammer change the field into Cave.
Mist Ball changes the field into Fairy Tale.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Dragon's Maw: 2× power for Dragon-type moves.
Magma Armor: Defense +1 and Special Defense +1 when it enters.
Marvel Scale: 1.5× Defense.
Shell Armor: Defense +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Hail cannot be started here.
Snow cannot be started here.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Special Attack +1 and powers up its Fire moves.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
